lane.description: Receive a shipment for one purchase order: verify the delivery, record what arrived, stage and put away the stock, and close the order. One run per purchase order. The discrepancy branch sends a short or damaged receipt to the Warehouse Manager for review.
lane.name: Receive Shipment

fields.description: Carrier who delivered the shipment, entered at step 1.1.
Delivery-note number from the carrier's paperwork, entered at step 1.1.
Date the shipment arrived, entered at step 1.1. Must match the PO's expected date.
Quantity on the delivery note, per order line, entered at step 1.2. Keyed by line id.
Rejection reason, per order line, entered at step 2.1 when units are rejected. Keyed by line id.
Receiving bin the goods are staged in (RCV-01 or RCV-02), entered at step 3.1.
Put-away bin, per order line, confirmed at step 3.3. Suggested by the Receiving Agent from the product's preferred bin. Keyed by line id.
Why the receipt is held, entered at step 2B.2 when the manager rejects the discrepancy.

steps.description: Confirm the truck and delivery: carrier, delivery-note number, received date.
steps.name: Confirm shipment arrived

validation.message: Received date must match the PO's expected date.

steps.description: Match each order line to the delivery note: enter the quantity on the delivery note per line. The Receiving Agent proposes the match; the receiver confirms or overrides. Runs once per order line.
steps.name: Match lines to the delivery note

steps.description: Per line: quantity received, quantity rejected and the rejection reason. The quantities are written to the PO lines; the reason is stored in run data. Runs once per order line.
steps.name: Enter received quantities

validation.message: Received + rejected must not exceed ordered for this line.

check.message: A line is short or has rejected units.

steps.description: Automatic check: every line fully received. If any line is short or rejected, the run branches to manager review instead of continuing to put-away.
steps.name: Discrepancy check

steps.description: The Warehouse Manager sees per-line ordered vs received vs rejected, with the receiver's note. Approve: continue to Stage 3 with the adjusted quantities; the PO becomes PARTIALLY_RECEIVED. Reject: the run goes to the hold step; no receipt is posted for the disputed lines.
steps.name: Review discrepancy

steps.description: Record why the receipt is held. Completing this step ends the run as held. Put-away never happens for the disputed lines. Resuming the receipt is a new run on the same PO.
steps.name: Record hold

steps.description: Assign a receiving bin for the staged goods: RCV-01 or RCV-02. The Receiving Agent proposes the bin; the receiver confirms or overrides.
steps.name: Stage the goods

steps.description: Post a RECEIPT StockMove per order line (MV-2026-016, MV-2026-017 for PO-2026-001). Runs once per order line. The move number is assigned by the Action Type; the ledger is append-only.
steps.name: Post receipt moves

steps.description: Confirm the put-away bin per line, suggested by the Receiving Agent from the product's preferred bin (HG-1001 and HG-1002 both go to A-01-03). Runs once per order line.
steps.name: Confirm put-away

steps.description: Post a PUTAWAY StockMove per order line (MV-2026-018, MV-2026-019 for PO-2026-001) and update stock on hand (48 to 88 for HG-1001, 22 to 52 for HG-1002). Runs once per order line. Available is recomputed, never written.
steps.name: Post put-away moves

steps.description: Read-only summary of the run: what was received, staged and put away, and the new on-hand quantities (88 / 52 for PO-2026-001). No fields to fill; completing the step moves on.
steps.name: Review summary

steps.description: Close the receipt. The Action Type closes the PO as RECEIVED when every line is fully received, or PARTIALLY_RECEIVED when the run took the discrepancy branch. The Warehouse Manager is notified automatically. This step replaces the wf-wh-01 put-away task: put-away already happened in Stage 3, so no duplicate task is created. The workflow stays the fallback for a PO that becomes RECEIVED outside a lane.
steps.name: Close the PO

notify.message: PO-2026-001 received: 40 x HG-1001, 30 x HG-1002. Stock on hand 88 / 52.
